chunks: They said: 'There will be no harm. We shall return to our Lord.'
ai.seo_question: What did the poets say about their return to God in Surah Al-Shu'ara?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Ash-Shu'ara, this verse captures the defiant assurance of the Quraysh poets who, despite facing divine warning, confidently declared their ultimate return to Allah without fear of lasting harm. Shia exegetes often highlight this as a declaration of resurrection and accountability, emphasizing that their 'return' is not merely physical but a spiritual reckoning where their deeds will be judged. This assertion serves as a precursor to the divine response, contrasting their self-assurance with the reality of the Hereafter.
